description: This file defines the Administrator class and related components for managing RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and message dispatching within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures for RPC communication and resource management.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and message dispatching, including registration, lookup, and resource management.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable RPC job with message and channel context.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server implementations handling job submission and revocation.

classes.name: InvokeServer
classes.description: Implements IIPCServer, managing a thread pool for processing RPC invocation messages.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Administrator.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a given action to all registered proxies and dangling proxies.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers a new interface with its stub and proxy types.

methods.name: Recall
methods.description: Unregisters an interface, cleaning up associated stub and proxy.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates and returns a new InvokeMessage proxy.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Removes a channel and handles pending proxies.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy instance for a given channel, implementation ID, and interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel, implementation, and interface.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a proxy is valid for a given channel, implementation, and interface ID.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for a proxy object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for a proxy object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a proxy and prepares a response.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Dispatches an invocation message over a channel.

methods.name: RegisterInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface implementation with the channel.

methods.name: UnregisterInterface
methods.description: Unregisters an interface from a channel, managing reference counts.
